_comment: Design intent for the encounter tables. Hand-editable. See docs/oxide/encounter-tool-design.md section 3.2. Thresholds are Ian's house rules; edit them here, never in lint.py. Rules tagged aspirational in lint.py sit beyond what vanilla Platinum does, on purpose.

encounters_eterna_forest.intent: The forest: Shroomish and Buneary at home, Sewaddle and Seedot with them, Blipbug small, Combee a 4% and Treecko the 1% under the trees.

encounters_lake_verity.intent: The lake shore, no one over 30%: Surskit at home by the water, Sentret and Wooloo with it, Buneary a 4% early rabbit, Mudkip the 1% lake tail.

encounters_lake_verity_low_water.intent: The same shore after the lake drains, the same cast: one location name, one capture.

encounters_mt_coronet_1f_north_room_1.intent: Mt. Coronet's first room, reachable in the Gardenia split: Bronzor's home, Nosepass where its evolution happens, Carbink in the rock.

encounters_oreburgh_gate_1f.intent: The first cave, five lines deep now: Zubat, Geodude, Nacli, Nosepass and Makuhita, none over 30.

encounters_oreburgh_gate_b1f.intent: The Rock Smash floor, the same location as 1F so the same capture: Geodude's home, Onix a 4% and Gible a 1% tease of Wayward Cave.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b1f.intent: The mine, Makuhita's home: Nacli and Zubat co-equal, Geodude behind, Phanpy in the tail.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b2f.intent: Deeper, and different: Onix and Phanpy at home, Nosepass in the rock.

encounters_ravaged_path.intent: The Rock Smash cave, five lines instead of a duo: Zubat, Geodude, Nacli, Makuhita, Phanpy.

encounters_route_201.intent: The first route, a capture area once the starter has its own met location (Ian's preference; backlog for the script track): Wooloo and Sentret at home, Pikipek the bird, Blipbug by night, Purrloin small.

encounters_route_202.intent: Shinx's route as in vanilla, at 30 rather than 40; Blipbug the early bug, Purrloin a regular by night.

encounters_route_203.intent: The road to Oreburgh: Rookidee leads, the Nidoran pair trade places by time of day, Purrloin at home, Makuhita a 4% preview of the caves, Torchic the 1%.

encounters_route_204_north.intent: The delay: Route 204 is one capture and this half is in the Gardenia split, so it is the better half. Scorbunny at home (moved from Route 206), Sewaddle and Bounsweet with it, Riolu a 4% and Eevee a 1% worth waiting for.

encounters_route_204_south.intent: Budew's route with Grubbin and Fletchling at home; the plain half of Route 204, so the north half is the one to wait for.

encounters_route_205_north.intent: The damp side before the forest, the better half of Route 205: Lotad at home, Surskit by night, Wooper (fully evolved by 20) a 4% and Dewpider the 1%.

encounters_route_205_south.intent: Floaroma's meadow: Pachirisu, Smoliv and Minccino at home, Skitty a regular at 10.

encounters_route_207.intent: The rocky road above Oreburgh: Ponyta and Vulpix at home, Vulpix taking the head at night, Houndour a 4% (fully evolved by 24) and Charmander the 1% fire tail.

encounters_route_211_west.intent: Route 211's west half is reachable from Eterna, the east half much later, so this is the delay's better half: Ralts and Mienfoo at home, Absol a 4% and Heracross a 1%.

encounters_valley_windworks_outside.intent: Electric at the windworks: Pawmi's home with Shinx and Pachirisu, Emolga a 4% and Pichu a 1% in the tail.

encounters_verity_lakefront.intent: A new capture area (the map still needs grass and its header pointed here): Pikipek and Blipbug at home, Purrloin a regular, Pachirisu a 4% and a 1% Vulpix as a tease of Route 207.

splits._comment: Ian's gym splits, in order, each with its hard level cap (null until he gives it) and the split each rod arrives in. Roark and Gardenia are his; the rest are the tool's reading of the route sequence, provisional.
